2026-09-19-benton-vs-university-academy-.headline: Benton beats University Academy Charter with Ewing Marion Kauffman, 28-14.
2026-09-19-benton-vs-university-academy-.story: Benton improved to 2-2 with a 28-14 win over University Academy Charter with Ewing Marion Kauffman; University Academy Charter with Ewing Marion Kauffman falls to 1-3. The pre-game projection had Benton by 4 (28-24) with a 60% chance to win. Benton's defense allowed 9 fewer points than projected.

2026-09-19-micds-vs-westminster-christia.headline: MICDS beats Westminster Christian Academy, 22-12.
